comment: USD per million tokens, by model family, for the board's cost-per-agent view. The engine's own ledger ($.session.usage().cost, what /cost shows) is the session total; the board splits that total across agents in proportion to each agent's tokens priced with this table, so the total is exact even when a price here is out of date. Edit a row when prices change. A model id matches the first family whose 'match' it contains.
